paite: "Pathian aw, kipahthu ka hon hilh uhi; kipahthu ka hon hilh uhi, na min anai ziak in; mi'n na thillamdang hih thute agengen uhi.
heading: Asaph phatna La / Pathian Vaihawmpa
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A Psalm by Asaph. A song. We give thanks to you, God. We give thanks, for your Name is near. Men tell about your wondrous works.

paite: "Hun seh pen ka muh hun chiang in diktak in vai ka hawm ding hi.
english: When I choose the appointed time, I will judge blamelessly.

paite: Lei leh asung a om tengteng azul khinta, ke'n abante ka phut ahi. Selah
english: The earth and all its inhabitants quake. I firmly hold its pillars. Selah.

paite: Mi-uangte kiang ah, 'Uangtak in om kei un,' ka chi a, migilou-saloute kiang ah, 'Na kii uh sangsak kei un,' leng ka chi hi.
english: I said to the arrogant, “Don’t boast!” I said to the wicked, “Don’t lift up the horn.

paite: Na kii uh tunglam ah hihsang kei unla; ngawng golh zen in thu gen kei un.
english: Don’t lift up your horn on high. Don’t speak with a stiff neck.”

paite: "Sansakna suahlam a kipan ahi kei a, tumlam a kipan leng ahi kei lai a, simlam a kipan ahi sam kei hi.
english: For neither from the east, nor from the west, nor yet from the south, comes exaltation.

paite: Pathian vaihawmpa ahi zaw; ama'n khat niamsak in khat asangsak hi.
english: But God is the judge. He puts down one, and lifts up another.

paite: TOUPA khut ah nou a om a, a-uain aphul a; thil dang toh hel in adim a, huai a pan abungkhia a; pel lou in aneng nangawn lei a migilou-salou tengteng in adawnsiang sinsin ding uhi.
english: For in Yahweh’s hand there is a cup, full of foaming wine mixed with spices. He pours it out. Indeed the wicked of the earth drink and drink it to its very dregs.

paite: "Himahleh ke'n zaw tangtawn in ka theisak ding a, Jakob' Pathian phat in la ka sa ding hi.
english: But I will declare this forever: I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.

paite: Migilou-saloute kii tengteng ka hihtan ding a; midiktatte kii zaw sansak in a-om ding hi.
english: I will cut off all the horns of the wicked, but the horns of the righteous shall be lifted up.
